Grazie per aver provato la versione in accesso anticipato di Heroes of Science and Fiction (o, in precedenza, Silence of the Siren)! 

Apprezziamo il vostro sostegno al gioco prima del suo rilascio completo e speriamo che vi divertiate un mondo con i contenuti inclusi. 

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere i vostri commenti e le segnalazioni di problemi e stiamo lavorando sodo per migliorare il gioco sulla base dei suggerimenti della comunità. 

Di seguito trovate i link alla sezione dedicata alla segnalazione dei problemi sul forum di Steam e al nostro Discord.
Ponti troppo lontani
The last two bridges connect the divided landscape; will the Fossorians or the Children of the Source find them first?

Hello Commander, the line of contact with the enemy is permanently broken. Scouts are reporting that there are only two bridges left. Acquire at least one Fusion core, use it to activate any of the bridges, reach and defeat the enemy before they do the same to you.
While bridges usually connect and unify, now a bridge has opened the path for destruction and devastation.
Greetings, commander! I am with the Keepers Guild. My brother, who is also a member, and I have been living here for an eternity. We started to get bored and play pranks on each other.

I want you to bring back the artifact that my brother hid from me. I can't get to it myself because he set dangerous creatures around it. I had the path to it blocked with stones for safety, but now it's clear for you. I will reward you generously.
I see that you haven't retrieved the artifact yet. Come back once you have it.
Thank you for retrieving my artifact. With little effort, I have outsmarted my brother once again. You can keep the artifact; I believe it will be safer with you.
And here is your reward.
I haven't come up with any new pranks for my brother yet.
Acquire the guarded artifact.
Return to the Keeper for your reward.
Crying river
The old dry river creates a barrier that splits the landscape into three territories. Will the Fossorians, the Children of the Source or the Sovereign fleet unite all territories under one rule?

Hello Commander, we have established small base in the area. Our intelligence services advise us about possible multiple enemies, so stay sharp. Your task is to build a strong base, gather as many troops as possible, search and destroy all enemies and take over all territory.
Obviously, this territory was also important to our enemies. Thank to you, commander, it is fully under our control.

Greetings, commander! I am with the Keepers Guild. Do you see the land around? It was once full of life, full of joy... \nSuch a rich country, thanks to the profits coming from orbital mines... \nNow there are only a few old miners surviving down here.

I am old and it is often very difficult to look on the bright side of life. I have lost my precious Magnesium torch somewhere in the old mines. If you find it and bring it to me, I will reward you generously.
I see that you haven't find the Magnesium torch yet. Come back once you have it.
I didn't believe that you could find it... I am truly impressed! \nYou can keep it, even your young eyes might need some extra help when exploring dark places...
And here is your reward.
There is nothing you could do for an old miner like me.
Bring back the lost Magnesium torch.
Return to the Keeper for your reward.
A volte è meglio attaccare un esercito più forte (rischio moderato o elevato) piuttosto che rimanere bloccati nei pressi della propria base.
Può essere vantaggioso assicurarsi un reddito sufficiente prima di investire nella produzione di unità.
In combattimento, puoi usare un'abilità da comandante per ogni round, purché tu disponga di energia sufficiente.
Fai attenzione quando attacchi con le tue unità a raggio limitato! Se ti avvicini troppo, la tua unità subirà un contrattacco proprio come se fosse un'unità da mischia.
Alcuni oggetti presenti sulla mappa di esplorazione creano zone che provocano effetti positivi o negativi nelle loro vicinanze. Fai attenzione a dove metti i piedi!
Non dimenticare di usare i tuoi oggetti consumabili al momento giusto! Ad esempio, quando ti manca solo un passo per catturare il tuo nemico.
Lo spostamento delle unità da un comandante all’altro comporta un consumo di punti movimento, quindi pianificate con attenzione le fusioni delle vostre armate!
Tutte le fazioni dispongono di un modo per sbloccare il viaggio rapido tra le basi.
Quando non hai accesso a una risorsa specifica, puoi sempre acquistarne una parte presso il tuo avamposto commerciale.
Quando affronti la fauna locale, assicurati di avvicinarti alle creature nel momento giusto, quando sono più vulnerabili!
Le macchine da guerra che puoi costruire in ogni base sono costose, ma possono cambiare le sorti della partita.
Se intorno a te continuano a succedere cose strane e alcune azioni ti sembrano troppo facili, probabilmente possiedi un'abilità speciale o un manufatto.

This old trinket increases the <color=SOTS_COLOR_GOLD>Morale</color> of your troops <color=SOTS_COLOR_GOLD>by 10</color>.
Increases the <color=SOTS_COLOR_GOLD>Morale</color> of your troops <color=SOTS_COLOR_GOLD>by 5</color>.
Immediately reveals a large area of the <color=SOTS_COLOR_INDIGO>nebbia di guerra</color> around the commander.
Radio Beacon
A powerful radio wave emitter. Its signal can be even located from orbit.

Without it, any planetary bombardment would be as precise as a drunkard's description of thermonuclear fusion. Which is not accurate, but surprisingly, it is not terrible either (on a planetary scale). But still, you may hit Slovenia instead of Slovakia.
"Radio Beacon"
A portable nuclear weapon disguised as a radio wave emitter.
Oh yes, it is definitely a "radio beacon". But seriously, we all know better this time. A nuclear weapon like this is a gift. A gift to the foes of the Supreme Leader and his regime.
The Relic
An ancient artifact. Its origin and purpose is unknown.

The item is stylized to look like an insect larva with a malevolent smile. Its origin or purpose is unknown, but with a design like this, it's hard to imagine it had a mundane purpose. I wouldn't take a cookie from a jar like this, would you? By the way, it is emitting strong theta waves.
L'unità è ipnotizzata e non può muoversi.
Imitazione (si trasforma in) qualsiasi unità presente sul campo di battaglia.
